items.title: ECC
items.summary: An MIT-licensed toolkit that adds a structured engineering workflow to coding agents: planning, testing, implementation, review, verification and memory, with reusable skills for repeated tasks. It works best with Claude Code and has adapters for other agent tools.

items.title: Modern Web Guidance
items.summary: A set of skills that gives coding agents current web platform knowledge and browser compatibility data. It nudges agents away from older JavaScript-heavy patterns and toward native browser features. It is stewarded by the Chrome, Edge, Firefox and MDN teams together with the web community.

items.title: Graphify
items.summary: A /graphify skill that turns a codebase and its docs, SQL schemas, configs and PDFs into a queryable knowledge graph. Code is parsed locally with deterministic AST parsing. Each connection is labelled as explicitly extracted or inferred, and it uses a graph rather than a vector store.
